liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls Eyes stellar, stretching on and on; Reviewer calls Eyes hot, along with the Space into The Wheel segment [7][12]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Jerry uses a wah pedal instead of the mutron, though he sits low in the mix [7]
- **Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad** (1 review): Reviewer was in the concourse near snacks when the band started it and rushed toward the field tunnel [13]

## The recordings

- **gd93-05-25.schoeps.vernon.19223.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 169 min; rated 3.83/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording lets you hear every beat and word clearly; Reviewer rates this audience tape as fair; Audience tape is not perfect but very good, with balanced sound [9][10][11]
- **gd1993-05-25.schoeps.evans.florek.34849.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 169 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboards of this run are crisp, but reviewer prefers audience tapes for more bass [16]
- **gd1993-05-25.fob.schoeps.mk2.GEMS.34853.flac1648**: source not stated; 20 songs; 169 min [3]
- **gd93-05-25.dsbd.vernon.19224.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 161 min; rated 3.8/5 by 10 [5]. Said about its sound: Recording sounded good to a 14-year-old on first hearing and still holds up [12]

## Around the show

- Reviewer lived three miles from Cal Expo, heard music from home, and enjoyed the lively parking lot scene over the three days [10]
- Dodging through a crowd of spinners on the way to the field tunnel [13]
- Cal Expo was one of the best venues, with a beer garden; reviewer returned the next year for its closing [15]
- Band was in good spirits across three nights, with perfect weather and vibe [16]
- Second set is above average overall, especially the portion before Drums [7]
- Reviewer says that after Hornsby left, good audience tapes beat soundboards, which sounded like an empty rehearsal hall [11]
- Reviewer finds soundboards clear but cold, lacking the warmth and excitement of audience tapes [14]
- Reviewer saw about 13 shows this tour and thought the band was on point [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd93-05-25.schoeps.vernon.19223.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Tom Bellanca; transferred by Matt Vernon; source: Audience: Schoeps [1]. Also: Schoeps microphones to DAT, then CDR via Tom Bellanca, encoded by Matt Vernon [1]
- **gd1993-05-25.schoeps.evans.florek.34849.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Todd Evans and John Florek; source: FOB Schoeps Mk2 Omni Capsule 7' spaced omnis in hat -> Schoeps Active Cables -> Schoeps CMC 5 Mic Body -> Monster M1000 Jumper -> Neumann Supply -> Canare… [2]
- **gd1993-05-25.fob.schoeps.mk2.GEMS.34853.flac1648**: transferred by Todd Evans; source: FOB Schoeps Mk2 Omni Capsule 7' spaced omnis in hat -> Schoeps Active Cables -> Schoeps CMC 5 Mic Body -> Monster M1000 Jumper -> Neumann Supply -> Canare… [3]. Also: Edits and tracking by john florek using WaveLab, CDWave and Trader's Little Helper; master clone fades retained; Gain was raised at the start of tracks, a pop softened, loud claps reduced, and clicks removed [3]
- **gd93-05-25.dsbd.vernon.19224.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD: DAT > DAT > Sonic Solutions > CD > CD encoded by Matt Vernon [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Cal Expo Amphitheatre - May 26, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/may-26-1993) [20]
- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1993-05-26 Cal Expo, Sacramento, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1993-05-26-cal-expo-sacramento-ca-usa/) [21]
- Poster by D.King Gallery: [Grateful Dead 5/25/1993 Sacramento Backstage Pass](https://www.dking-gallery.com/store/Dead_Pass_930525.html) [22]
